verdict.rationale: This axis applies: any documented tool could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. Probes found that pandoc.org/llms.txt returns HTTP 404 and that a markdown version of the manual (MANUAL.html.md) also returns 404. Nothing in the pack shows an agent-oriented documentation surface; the HTML manual is ordinary human-facing docs, and Pandoc's ability to convert formats does not count as agent docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
